text:
SoFi Stadium buee wɔ 8 September 2020 wɔ Inglewood, California, ɛsɔre wɔ former Hollywood Park Racetrack site no so wɔ Hollywood Park development no mu. HKS, Inc. na ɛdesign, na ɛyɛ cost a wɔestimate sɛ roughly $5.5 billion wɔ May 2020 mu, ɛde no kɔ one of the most expensive stadiums a wɔabɔ no mu. Ownership wɔ StadCo LA ne Hollywood Park Land Company nkyɛn, a ɛbɔ Stan Kroenke ho.

Wɔde beae no kyerɛɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ home ma NFL franchises two, Los Angeles Rams ne Los Angeles Chargers, a wɔn nyinaa tena hɔ firi 2020. Ne feature a ɛda adi paa ne freestanding translucent ETFE canopy a ɛtraverse about one million square feet across 302 panels, a ɛwɔ dual-sided oval 4K Infinity Screen video board no ase.

Firi ne seasons a ɛdi kan no, stadium no kɔɔ biggest events wɔ American sport mu. Ɛhosting Super Bowl LVI wɔ February 2022, ɛberɛ a Rams dii Bengals 23-20, na ɛstaging 2023 College Football Playoff National Championship. Ne football pedigree bɛhyɛɛ ase sɛ ɛbɛkɔ so, CONCACAF ne CONMEBOL fixtures a ɛwɔ top-tier no de international crowds baa Inglewood.

Ma World Cup no, wɔde official branding "Los Angeles Stadium" ma stadium no wɔ FIFA's clean-venue, neutral-naming policy ase, na ne regular capacity 70,240 no wɔset sɛ FIFA-confirmed 70,492 ma tournament no. Wɔma ne artificial turf so na wɔde natural-grass pitch bae, hybrid Kentucky bluegrass surface a wɔgrow over layered drainage ne ventilation structure a ɛwɔ grow lighting sɛdeɛ ɛbɛ sustain living grass wɔ canopy ase.

Ɛda adi sɛ, SoFi Stadium wɔ hɔ sɛ ɛbɛ hosting opening ne closing ceremonies of 2028 Summer Olympics, ɛde ne ho kɔ one of the defining venues of ne era mu. Wɔ span a ɛyɛ remarkably short mu no, ɛfiri horse-racing site kɔɔ one of the most recognizable stadiums wɔ world no mu, ɛwɔ home sɛ ɛbɛ staging NFL season, Super Bowl, ne global game nnɛ.
